waves.notes: Bounded delete(policy, sha) (index first then bin, link_info before every removal, symlinks and hard links refused untouched, half-present objects handled) and reclaim_expired(policy, now_ms, max_objects) with a receipt (examined, removed, refused, bytes_freed, truncated; expiry re-read before each delete; malformed indexes reported, not deleted). Closes the media design safety requirement that a stored unit is deletable on request (review M-11 residual). Own Sa-plan task MEDIA_RECLAIM. Process defect: the 6c packet had scoped T4 below the design safety requirement and recorded the omission as a limit.

waves.mutants: 6/6 worker (counter never increments, pause unreachable, history unbounded, RunNow reschedules, max_objects ignored, Resume does not reset) plus 1 integrator re-observation

A deleted store base is an empty store by the store law, so the error path is provoked by an unlistable base. Closes the media lifecycle at source; production placement is deployment configuration.

lessons.lesson: A landing chain joined with ';' let a HOLD pass; gate on the literal ACTIVE_OBSERVATION_PASS string
Workers sharing one scratch directory overwrite each other
lessons.applied: per-worker scratch directories in every packet

lessons.lesson: jj restore --from <commit> <dir> deletes files absent from that commit
An independent reviewer that can reject is worth more than one that only approves; both rejections corrected a real ordering error
lessons.applied: reviewer told explicitly to disagree; second-round re-verification when bytes change

lessons.lesson: Mermaid chained arrows and parenthesised labels fail diagram-check
lessons.applied: one edge per line; diagram-check in the per-wave gate

lessons.lesson: Leases shorter than the integrator's session expire silently; a whole set of same-worker attempts then needs a reclaim set, and a boilerplate portfolio ties them all at an inherited score
lessons.applied: 3h leases sized to intent; checker gains a reviewed reclaim-set mode; residual re-assessment of sibling records against landed evidence before any review

lessons.lesson: Editing the checker after re-hashing the portfolio invalidates the portfolio's own evidence row for the checker file
lessons.applied: rehash last, immediately before the preflight; review bytes regenerated and re-approved

lessons.lesson: Two generated documents were first named with guessed future timestamps (0740, 0825) while the host UTC clock read 06:39; prefixes must come from date -u at write time, never from a sense of elapsed work
lessons.applied: renamed to the observed mtimes 0639 and 0640; every prefix in this session is now taken from the host clock immediately before the Write

lessons.lesson: A service-level test needs the Sa-plan fence (plan, executing task, bridge mapping and lease); preparing it belongs in an OCaml fixture against the Store API, not in Python or ad-hoc SQL
lessons.applied: engines/hermes/modules/sa_plan/test/verify_fence_fixture.exe, invoked through development.bounded by the Gleam test

lessons.lesson: gleam format reflows a one-line condition into several lines, so a mutant pattern copied from the pre-format source silently does not match
lessons.applied: mutant patterns are taken from the formatted file; PATTERN NOT FOUND is treated as not planted, never as killed

lessons.lesson: The Telegram store transport and the Sa-plan frame transport are different workers behind one guardian; an action profile that points the store worker at a Sa-plan database answers unknown_command
lessons.applied: service verify test uses sa_plan_cancel_worker.exe for the profile transport; recorded in the wave 6b journal section 9

lessons.lesson: An independent reviewer with the full diff found that the guardian ran outside any Sa-plan claim; the author tests had normalised it
lessons.applied: claim before exec and complete after are now laws with tests; every signed-approval change gets an R2 review before landing while R5 sessions are stale

lessons.lesson: A mutant that falls through to the same arm it replaced is equivalent and proves nothing; design mutants that change an observable the law asserts
lessons.applied: the vision-fixture mutant was replaced by one that derives amber_led from the byte count; the equivalent one is not counted

lessons.lesson: A bound that outputs cannot reveal (every signature sits inside the first 12 bytes) needs its own observation accessor and a law over it
lessons.applied: telegram_media_inspect exposes examined_prefix; the bound-ignored mutant dies only on that law

lessons.lesson: The OCaml-or-Mojo mandate covers helper scripts and fixtures; sed -i applying one literal edit is a host utility, Python, awk and perl one-liners remain barred
lessons.applied: answered worker w1 in the journal; the shared worker packet states it

lessons.lesson: Author tests of a store exercised only complete writes; the independent reviewer found the majors by enumerating interrupted, aged and half-present objects
lessons.applied: every module that writes to disk or executes gets an R2 review before the wave closes; the review prompt asks for crash, race and expiry cases by name

lessons.lesson: Completing Sa-plan tasks after a landing invalidates the risk portfolio records that still declare them executing; the next landing gate holds on RP-SA-PLAN
lessons.applied: complete6*.sh now ends by aligning the portfolio task_state with Sa-plan, re-stamping and rehashing

lessons.lesson: A design safety requirement is a deliverable, not a limit to document; a packet that scopes below it must say so as a gap with its own task
lessons.applied: MEDIA_RECLAIM opened as a task with dependency MEDIA_FIX; the wiki guide and skill now describe the full lifecycle

lessons.lesson: Running gleam format on a shared file that was never formatter-clean rewrites the whole file and hides the increment; format only new files and read jj diff --stat before trusting a build
